card.name: Large counts in genetics study descriptions
card.fires_on: Small words or spaces just before a big number of people, genes or markers in descriptions of genetic studies, such as "hundreds of" or "over" before a count. Also appears on words leading into a study's sample size.

modes.label: Of after hundreds
modes.description: The word "of" after a large-number word like hundreds or thousands, before DNA markers.
modes.example: enabling scientists to scan hundreds of thousands<< of>> DNA markers at once.

modes.label: Space before a count
modes.description: The gap right before a numeral giving the size of a studied group.
modes.example: In a study examining the DNA of over<< >>95,000 people,

modes.label: Verbs leading into sample
modes.description: Words like at or examining that lead into the data set studied.
modes.example: DeCode Genetics’ group looked<< at>> the DNA shared by 78 groups

card.plain: It lights up just before a big number is given for how many people, genes or items a study looked at.
